title: Validation Error State
description: The failed-submission state: error summary at top, errored inputs with linked messages, resubmit button.

components.reason: Focus target after failed submission; lists every error as an anchor link
The errored field's form group with linked govuk-error-message
Instantiate with govuk-input--error + aria-invalid='true' for each failing field

nesting: Component 1 above the form; component 3 inside component 2 (in error state); component 4 last
validationOrder: Summary link text matches the field error wording exactly
Every failing field has aria-invalid='true' and aria-describedby pointing at its error id
Focus moves to the error summary
a11yNotes: Error links anchor to real control ids
agentPromptSequence: 1. Place the error summary as the first element in main
2. For each failing field, switch its form group to the error variant and add the error message
